product.insight: Our backend foundation is rock-solid, and the Packages feature demonstrates our velocity when teams are aligned. However, mobile stagnation is existential - we cannot launch a modern platform without native apps. The next 48 hours are critical: we must decide iOS strategy and restart Android immediately. Wallet compliance is our second-highest priority - without monetization, we have a demo, not a business.

technology.insight: Backend and admin dashboard are executing well with Docker containerization complete and auth systems robust. The 30+ web app branches signal good experimentation but require consolidation. Critical gap: mobile engineering capacity. We need either to reassign existing engineers or bring in contractors for Android/iOS sprint. Recommend MVP scope reduction on Ride Hailing to improve launch probability.

engineering.insight: Team velocity on backend is strong (6 commits/week), but mobile silence is alarming. Android has the foundation (100 commits) - we just need resourcing. iOS is a greenfield problem requiring strategic decision. The Packages feature sync between backend/frontend proves our integration workflow works. Focus areas: 1) Mobile resourcing NOW, 2) AI feature prioritization (implement 4, defer 4), 3) Admin dashboard merge must not slip.
